messages:
Maria P: ok team, kicking off a short Q3 roadmap thread for Hosted inference. Need to decide priorities across three asks: embeddings consistency + cache, chat streaming & latency SLOs, and a high-precision rerank mode. Customers are pushing for different things (Searchly -> deterministic embeddings, Shopwise -> sub-150ms chat p95). Can we quickly call out launch criteria, rough effort, and major risks? I suggest we treat this as M1 (must ship) vs M2 (deferred / gated).

Ashwin R: quick take — embeddings caching is relatively contained. Implementation: prefix/KV cache in the runtime + small API change. Effort ~2w eng + 1w infra for invalidation and metrics. Risk: multi-tenant cache invalidation complexity and memory blowups for long-tail vectors. Canary to 5% should be safe.

Hana K: rerank high-precision mode is more ML-heavy. We need an eval harness (5k curated pairs) and model quantization experiments. Perf hit could be 1.8-2x token cost. Launch criteria: no >1.5% regression on our rerank NDCG on core bench, and latency p95 < 400ms on Dedicated. Otherwise it stays opt-in.

Leah S: from customers — Searchly wants deterministic-ish embeddings (seed control + stable quantization) and an SLA for "similarity drift". Shopwise will only accept chat improvements if streaming reduces perceived latency (first-byte) under 200ms for short prompts. Both want docs and migration notes.

Robert V: UX note — we should expose a simple knob in Console/SDK: `response_quality` with values [balanced, low-latency, high-precision]. Default = balanced. Add a tooltip explaining cost/latency tradeoffs.

Maria P: good. Proposed prioritization: M1 = embeddings cache + chat streaming improvements (low-latency path). M2 = rerank high-precision gated by eval results and cost opt-ins. Ship criteria for M1:
- embeddings: stability checks + sampling drift < 0.5% on existing customers, cache TTL + invalidation docs, canary at 5% for 2 weeks.
- chat streaming: reduce first-byte p95 by 30% on internal trace; add streaming fallback and docs.

Ashwin R: sounds right. I'll draft a 2-sprint plan for M1. Quick config prototype: ```json
{"cache_ttl": 3600, "canary_percent": 5, "rerank_mode": "opt_in"}
```

Hana K: I'll spin up the eval harness and get initial baselines by EOD+3. Need product to lock required bench metrics (NDCG threshold) and a dedicated dataset owner.

Leah S: I'll coordinate with Searchly & Shopwise to sign off on criteria (they're ok with canaries). I'll also draft migration docs for embedding stability.

Robert V: I'll mock the Console control and SDK flag; will drop a quick prototype gif in the design channel tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for service=runtime-hosted, percent=5. ETA 2024-06-12T18:00Z.

Maria P: thanks. Action items: @Ashwin — plan + timeline by EOD tomorrow; @Hana — eval baseline in 3 days; @Leah — customer sign-offs; @Robert — mock by tomorrow. We'll reconvene after the baselines. Short and focused — please keep replies as confirmations. :thumbsup:
